name: Manoranjan Shau

bio: Dr. Manoranjan Shau is a highly experienced Naturopathy doctor with 15 years of expertise in the medical sector. He is a specialist in various health issues such as migraine, neurological disorders, and the treatment of piles, fissures, and fistula. Dr. Shau also addresses psychological issues with a holistic approach. His educational background includes a degree of Bachelor of Naturopathy and Yogic Sciences (B.N.Y.S). Dr. Shau's extensive experience and specialized knowledge helps him provide effective treatment to his patients and makes him a trusted practitioner in the medical field.
